import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bar: rows with >=2 distinct nonzero colors, same pattern
    bar=None
    for r in range(h):
        row=g[r]; nz=[c for c in row if c]
        if len(set(nz))>=2 and all(tuple(row)==tuple(g[rr]) for rr in [r]):
            pass
    # simpler: find contiguous rows identical, multicolor
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(c for c in g[r] if c))>=2:
            r2=r
            while r2<h and g[r2]==g[r]: r2+=1
            if r2-r>=2: bar=(r,r2); break
    r0,r1=bar
    cols=[c for c in g[r0] if c]
    # bounding box of a shape: cells of some single color != bar colors
    shape_color=None
    colorset=set()
    for row in g:
        for c in row:
            if c and c not in cols: colorset.add(c)
    # gather shape mask from first such color
    sc=sorted(colorset)[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==sc]
    ri=[i for i,j in cells]; ci=[j for i,j in cells]
    mr0,mr1,mc0,mc1=min(ri),max(ri),min(ci),max(ci)
    mask=[(i-mr0,j-mc0) for i,j in cells]
    H=mr1-mr0+1
    # existing shapes of bar colors: find rows occupied per color
    exist={}
    for c in cols:
        cc=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        if cc:
            rr=[i for i,j in cc]
            exist[c]=(min(rr),max(rr))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # place existing shapes
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] in exist: out[i][j]=g[i][j]
    # contiguous stack in bar order: existing shapes fixed; place missing to make contiguous
    # anchor: use existing shapes' vertical extent as reference; fill missing above/below
    # compute target rows: bar order list; existing colors at their rows; missing placed contiguously
    # strategy: stack slots of height H from top of combined extent
    # find combined extent of existing shapes
    tops=[v[0] for v in exist.values()]; bots=[v[1] for v in exist.values()]
    # determine slot index of existing shapes assuming contiguous stack aligned with bar order
    order=cols
    # existing colors must occupy consecutive slots; find their slot indices
    idx=[order.index(c) for c in exist]
    # anchor slot position: use first existing color's top row minus idx*H
    c0=order[min(idx)]
    anchor_top=exist[c0][0]-min(idx)*H
    for k,c in enumerate(order):
        top=anchor_top+k*H
        for (di_,dj_) in mask:
            i,j=top+di_, mc0+dj_
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=c
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bar=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(c for c in g[r] if c))>=2:
            r2=r
            while r2<h and g[r2]==g[r]: r2+=1
            if r2-r>=2: bar=(r,r2); break
    r0,r1=bar
    cols=[c for c in g[r0] if c]
    inb=lambda i: r0<=i<r1
    sc=next(c for c in cols if any(g[i][j]==c and not inb(i) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)))
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==sc and not inb(i)]
    mr0,mr1,mc0=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells),min(j for i,j in cells)
    mask=[(i-mr0,j-mc0) for i,j in cells]
    H=mr1-mr0+1
    exist={}
    for c in cols:
        cc=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c and not inb(i)]
        if cc: exist[c]=min(cc)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    idxs=[k for k,c in enumerate(cols) if c in exist]
    anchor_top=exist[cols[min(idxs)]]-min(idxs)*H
    for k,c in enumerate(cols):
        top=anchor_top+k*H
        for (di_,dj_) in mask:
            i,j=top+di_, mc0+dj_
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=c
    return out
